# lcd.invalidate

<div class="api-badges"><span class="api-badge api-badge--since">since 1.1.0</span></div>

Invalidate the window or a part of the window (it will be fully drawn on next LCD refresh)

```lua
lcd.invalidate([x[, y[, w[, h]]]])
```

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `x` | number | optional | X coordinate |
| `y` | number | optional | Y coordinate |
| `w` | number | optional | rectangle width |
| `h` | number | optional | rectangle height |

## Returns

Nothing.

## Examples

```lua title="From the official Ethos documentation"
lcd.invalidate()
lcd.invalidate(0, 0, 100, 100)
```
